improvedVsOld: Clearly better than the removed text. It replaces the calques 'parcs pour caravanes', 'parc de vacances' and 'votre prochain lieu est quelque part dehors' and the planning-table sentence. It aligns the app labels (« J’ai aimé », « Favoris », « Envie de visiter », « Épingles », « tâches », « liste de choses à emporter »), replaces 'hors connexion' with 'sans réseau' and 'intégré à l’app', and uses imperatives in headings. Typography is correct throughout the changed units: U+00A0 before : ; ? » and inside numbers, typographic apostrophes, and no em dashes. There are no offline-map claims. Numbers (74 000+, 4 000+, 11 l, 9 l), AUD and the RBA are intact, and brand names are untouched. One regression against the old text: ui.driveTitle. Minor style note: 'caravan park' and 'holiday park' are never glossed on the home page or the tools page, which the glossary asks for once per page.
criticalIssues: The French privacy page is missing the 'Website analytics' (Google Analytics 4 / Google Ireland) section. English has 7 privacy sections and French has 6. The keys pages.privacy.sections[4].paragraphs[1..3] and sections[6].* do not exist in fr.json, and French sections [4] onward are shifted by one against English. This fails the style guide's completeness gate (§7), and for EEA visitors it is a GDPR disclosure gap on a site that now loads GA4.

The consent banner namespace is untranslated. consent.label, consent.message, consent.accept, consent.decline, consent.learnMore and consent.privacyChoices are absent from fr.json, but the style guide (§7) says the consent namespace follows the same rules once it reaches en.json.

pages.privacy.effective still says 12 août 2026 while English says 19 October 2026, and pages.privacy.sections[3].paragraphs[1] keeps the 'n’utilise pas de traceurs publicitaires' sentence that English removed. Together they present an outdated privacy policy as current.

failingUnits.problem: Fact fidelity: the second sentence is not in the English. English main deliberately dropped it when GA4 went live, so the French privacy policy now makes a claim the English no longer makes, on a site that runs Google Analytics 4. Score 2.
failingUnits.suggested: Les hébergeurs peuvent traiter des journaux techniques courants (adresse IP, type de navigateur, URL demandée) pour la diffusion, la fiabilité et la sécurité du site.

failingUnits.problem: Wrong date. The English says 'Effective 19 October 2026'. The French policy also still lacks the new GA4 section (see critical issues), so it presents an outdated policy as current. Score 2.
failingUnits.suggested: En vigueur depuis le 19 octobre 2026 (only once the Website analytics section has been added to the French file)

failingUnits.current: Combien de temps prend vraiment cette journée.
failingUnits.problem: Reads as a question with a full stop. A native writer would not leave an indirect question without a main clause. The old text was better. Score 3.

failingUnits.problem: 'Préparer toute la route' is an odd collocation in French. A native writer would say 'préparer le voyage' or 'le trajet'. Score 3.5.
failingUnits.suggested: Trouvez. Enregistrez. Préparez tout le voyage.
